notes: Public redacted record of enforcement actions at Stage 2 and above. Stage 0 and Stage 1 matters are published only in aggregate in the annual transparency report. Personal data is minimised. See legal/enforcement-policy.md and governance/REGISTRY-POLICY.md §10.
principles: No entry without a signed decision from an authorised enforcement authority.
Entries are append-only; corrections are new entries that reference the original.
An action overturned on appeal is annotated prominently.
